name: Prestige removes the Books of Ascension ranks of Night Hunter's Howl (#5658)
contract: Night Hunter's Howl ranks 6-8 (501684, 501685, 501686; Spell.dbc BaseLevel 51, 61, 71) are sold only through the Books of Ascension upgrade rows in modules/mod-spellbook/src/SpellbookRankData.h:43-45 and the class trainer 900020 rows that require rank 4 (501682). They are absent from AscensionCompatData::ClassSpells, LegacyGeneratedClassSpells and AscensionProgression::Ranks, so neither CoAPrestige ForgetRanksAbove (CoAPrestige.cpp:342) nor SynchronizeProgression (AscensionCompat.cpp:664) takes them back when Chromie returns a level-60 character to level 1. A prestiged character must not keep a rank above its level: after activation rank 6 (BaseLevel 51) is forgotten, the same as rank 4 (501682, BaseLevel 58), which AscensionProgression::Ranks already covers.

steps.label: Control: rank 4 (level 58, in AscensionProgression::Ranks) is forgotten
DISCRIMINATING: rank 6 (level 51, Books of Ascension upgrade row) is forgotten
